description: Clean up the document by removing unused paragraph/character styles, unused swatches, empty layers and/or hidden page items. Use dryRun to list what would be removed.

dryRun.description: Only report what would be removed

removeHiddenElements.description: Remove page items that are hidden (visible = false) (default false)

removeUnusedColors.description: Remove unused swatches (built-in [bracketed] swatches are kept) (default false)

removeUnusedLayers.description: Remove layers with no page items and no guides (the last layer is kept) (default false)

removeUnusedStyles.description: Remove paragraph and character styles not applied to any text (built-in [bracketed] styles are kept) (default false)

name: cleanup_document
title: Cleanup Document
